_comment: Single source of truth for launch facts. Pages, docs and the README must read from here instead of hard-coding a chain, a venue, an address or a status. Values still written as {{PLACEHOLDER}} are not decided yet: render them as 'to be announced' (the site does this in app/lib/token.ts) and never print the placeholder itself to a visitor. When a value is final, replace the placeholder here, rebuild, and the whole surface follows.

token.name: Fruit Fly World
token.statusNote: No token exists. Nothing is on sale, nothing is mintable, and no airdrop is promised.

passport.statusNote: Coming soon. The mint interface is switched off; nothing is being issued and nothing is claimable.

trading.statusNote: Paper season: the coins are invented and the prices come from a seeded generator. No real money moves anywhere, and the wallet is simulated.

x402.statusNote: Not open yet. Opens after launch; prices will be published here first.
